description.value: Foo is an Asian fusion restaurant on Yates Street in downtown Victoria, drawing from Japanese, Thai, Chinese, and South Asian cuisines with a rotating daily specials board alongside a regular menu. The kitchen highlights ethically raised, free-range meats from Farm + Field and offers a notably broad selection of vegetarian and gluten-free dishes. Takeout is available by phone and online order, making it a practical downtown stop for cyclists moving through the city core.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (23 spaces, covered) at 77m. Total: 23 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at victoria.foofood.ca is live and confirms the restaurant name, address (769 Yates Street, Victoria), and phone (250-383-3111), all consistent with OSM tags. The website explicitly lists pickup/takeout ordering and marks many menu items with 'v' (vegetarian), 'vegan', and 'gf' (gluten-free) symbols. No information about bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities appears on the website or in OSM tags beyond outdoor_seating=yes (which is an OSM amenity tag, not confirmed by the website).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant with a live website, confirmed address, and current menu. Publicly accessible and useful to touring cyclists in downtown Victoria.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website marks numerous menu items with 'v' (vegetarian) and 'gf' (gluten-free); sides include 'Togarashi Tots w/ Chili Mayo (Vegan)'; examples include Coconut Chickpea Curry (v), Kung Pao Tofu (v gf), Red Coconut Curry–Tofu option (v gf), Papaya Salad (v gf)
